premises: Ion nitriding of Grade 5 titanium alloy forms a titanium nitride-rich surface layer.
Active screen ion nitriding at 530–590 °C for 5–17 h increases surface hardness to ~1021 HK0.025.
The nitride layer improves wear resistance compared to untreated alloy.
The improvement is confined to the surface layer without altering bulk properties.
